```plato

    // The multiplicative inverse: the conjugate divided by the squared magnitude.
    // Precondition: the quaternion is not zero.
    Inverse(self: Quaternion): Quaternion {
        var invNorm = 1.0 / self.LengthSquared;
        return (-self.X * invNorm, -self.Y * invNorm, -self.Z * invNorm, self.W * invNorm);
    }
```
